# airlock_group_process (Resource)

Manage a parent or grandparent process rule on an Airlock policy group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "airlock_group_process" "example" {
  group_id = "1700000004"
  type     = "pprocess"
  value    = "example.exe"
  comment  = "Example parent process"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) Airlock policy group ID.
- `type` (String) Process type: pprocess or gprocess.
- `value` (String) Process name.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable Terraform import ID for this Airlock relationship.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import airlock_group_process.example 1700000004:pprocess:example.exe
```
